Dusron ke business aur platforms ko neecha dikha kar apne affiliate business ko promote karna koi unbiased journalism nahi hai. 14 minute ki video mein 10-15 baar Delta Exchange ka promotion karne se aapki baatein sach nahi ho jaati. Pehle apni trading performance aur credibility par dhyaan dijiye, phir dusron par sawaal uthaiye.

Ek naye trader ke liye ₹10,000–₹20,000 lekar Delta Exchange par trading start karna kitna risky ho sakta hai, ye bhi samajhna zaroori hai. 2-3 din mein capital khatam ho sakta hai, jabki prop firms mein relatively limited fees ke saath traders ko risk management, discipline aur consistency seekhne ka mauka mil sakta hai.

Mere ek dost ne Delta Exchange par ₹30,000 deposit kiye aur trading se ₹50,000 profit banaya, lekin usne ₹80,000 se zyada trading charges pay kiye. Aaj uska account zero hai. Toh naye traders ko sirf apna affiliate business chalane ke liye ek platform promote karne ke bajaye uske actual trading costs aur risks ke baare mein bhi honestly batayiye.
